errors.description: MATCHED PAIR GATE FAILURE. The besom and welt watch pockets came back near-identical - both read as a thin double-jetted line under the waistband. A customer could not tell which is which, which is the only thing these two options differ by.
errors.expected: a deep, heavy double-jetted slot with two fine jets closing on each other and a visibly dark open interior - no strip filling the mouth
errors.actual: a thin jetted line, indistinguishable from the welt sibling
errors.correction: Shoot the pair together. For the besom, open the mouth so the interior reads as a genuine dark recess with clear depth and explicitly no strip filling it. Raking light along the mouth so the two jet lips each throw a shadow.
